subject: Codistillation status: reproduction + fabric contention
body:
Hi both,

Status on reproduction: the two-replica online distillation run matches our data-parallel baseline's validation loss with 1.7x better wall-clock at equal hardware, consistent with the paper's finding that distillation targets act as a stabilizer at large batch counts. Saoirse's prediction-exchange layer is in; checkpoint-free teacher updates every 500 steps.

Data side is clean — Efe rebuilt the training set from the released paragraph IDs (delta decode, then join against the Crawl snapshot), so our numbers are directly comparable to the paper's setup.

The risk: at 4+ replicas the exchange traffic contends with the input pipeline on titan's shared network fabric. Options are (a) staler predictions, exchanged every 2k steps, or (b) requesting a dedicated slice. (a) costs maybe 2% quality by early measurements; measuring properly this week.

Tereza
